chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered upon Aishah while she was counting/keeping track of the bread. He said: 'O Aishah, do not count the bread, lest it be counted against you.'

key_terms.فَيُحْصَى عَلَيْكِ: Lest it be counted against you

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Prophet's advice to Aishah not to count the bread?
ai.summary: In the context of *al-Hukrah* (hoarding or reserving goods), this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the Prophet’s (SAW) warning against excessive scrutiny of provisions, which can lead to spiritual burden or *Hisab* (accountability). Shia scholars interpret 'counted against you' as a reminder that meticulous tracking of worldly sustenance may distract from gratitude and trust in God, turning simple provision into a source of anxiety or sin. This aligns with the broader Shia emphasis on moderation and avoiding the greed associated with hoarding.
